$comment: p15-oracle-074: the appearance and toggle action families (every non-excluded id of plans/cmux-next/action-surfaces.json whose family_of is appearance: 66 today). gen_actions.py (p15-oracle-071) reads this file (load_tuning: only $comment and actions; each spec's keys in TUNING_KEYS, each before step a case-v1 step with an op) and writes one flat case per action; regeneration keeps it byte-stable. Not tuned: toggleFileEditorWordWrap (every-action-gaps.json lists it: p15-oracle-082's file page fixture) and appearance.animations.feedback.toggle (excluded); appearance.glass.lens.toggle is debug-only, so the sweep's plan blocks it by flag and its entry is the expectation for a debug arm. Settings facet assertions: an action that writes a non-default value waits until /settings/nonDefaultKeys contains its key; one that writes the default first makes the key non-default in a before step, then waits until the list changed; the motion actions read the arm back (/settings/motion/enabled and speed, MotionSpeed.timeScale fast 1, normal 1.5, off 0). The oracle launch is the bench config plus ui.animations.enabled false, appearance.backgroundOpacity 1 and mcp.enabled true (driver_app.py ORACLE_CONFIG). Every key these actions write is agent-settable (SettingsSchema.agentSettableKeys), so a socket caller may write it; the handlers apply the value at once and return the cmux-next.json write as tracked work (AppActionContext.writeSettings), so action.run answers after the file has it. Legacy bind/run/invoke handlers report action.done. A toggle's generated restore runs it again (the sweep's TOGGLES); app_reset puts the settings back between cases. Page actions (toggleBrowser*, toggleReactGrab, toggleTabAudioMute) take their page from the generator's chromium context step and require chromium. Divergences are stated in their actions' invariants: pane-border-toggle-reads-configured, pane-padding-toggle-noop-default-style, design-mode-unlocalized-refusal, react-grab-untracked-work. Chromium: a case per command, as chrome/browser/ui/browser_command_controller_unittest.cc checks each command on its own browser; the settings facet reads the applied prefs as components/prefs/pref_service.cc reports them.
